ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (~5%) to low-intensity pixels (~95%); the surface is predominantly low-intensity black with sparse high-intensity white punctate markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant continuous black field across both lobes. High-contrast white spots are distributed across the mid-lateral and distal regions. Specific high-contrast linear marks are localized on the far distal-left region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the central axis; estimated pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees with a vertical depth of ~12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; amplitude of peaks varies from 3 to 12 pixels, with the most pronounced and jagged topography located on the distal 25% of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve on the posterior boundary of both lobes, tapering into sharp, recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous discrete, roughly circular high-intensity pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameters) scattered across both lobes, with higher density in the medial-to-distal transition zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear streaks on the distal portion of the left lobe, varying from 15 to 45 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, protruding three-dimensional cluster of heterogeneous high-intensity and earth-toned pixels (barnacle colony) is attached to the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentric curvilinear ridges are visible near the distal tips of both lobes, creating a 'washboard' texture that follows the sweep of the trailing edge.
